subject: Class 456 in South West Trains red with South Western Railway branding, as withdrawn (2022-01-17)
method: Bodyside from the SWR-era diagram (dia, Benspiersphotos, on the Unisouth template; dias is the template's Southern version), axes calibrated as the 455's (same template, same wheel and door pixels) and checked against 456004 (p004) by a 1D projective fit along the window row; the cab end (cab door, short window) from that fit, where it disagrees with the drawing; face from the nearly head-on part of p004; sweep from the diagram, checked on p004; colours sampled from p004 against the white wordmark and the white front number. No camera match (no Blender in this pass).

calibration.notes: Same template as the 455 diagram: bogie centres 267 and 1285 px (1018 px = 14.17 m -> 71.84 px/m), rail 345 to roof 38 (307 px = 3.77 m -> 81.4 px/m). x is from the nose's foot (58 px, the lower front, rows 244..300); the face leans back to 88 px at 3.5 m. The cab car reads 58..1524 px = 20.41 m at the foot, 19.99 m at the top of the face (published 19.95 m, so the published length is the upper body's). The second car (DTSO) is the cab car reversed: drawn 1581..3046 px, its doors 438.5 px (6.10 m) and 937.5 px (13.05 m) from its inner end, as the cab car's from its rear.

trace.heights: dia, same template rows as the 455: bottom row 272 -> 0.897, roof band to row 56 -> 3.55, roof row 38 -> 3.77 (published 3.78), glass rows 97..175 -> 3.047..2.088.
trace.wheel, wheelbase: As the 455 (same template, BP20-type bogies drawn identically): 0.84, 2.6.
trace.cab.length: dia 58..1524 px = 20.41 m from the nose's foot (19.99 m from the face's top, published 19.95 m). p004's fit puts the face corner at the window row (u 2613) at x 0.12 against the profile's 0.18-0.21 there: the drawn nose length holds.
trace.cab.doors[0]: Cab door from p004, not the drawing: the 1D fit through six window edges (residuals <= 2.3 cm) puts its edges at 1.61 and 2.35 m (u 2472, 2408), centre 1.98, w 0.74, and the drop light at 1.758..2.056 (u 2459..2433), panes -0.222..0.076 about the centre. The drawing has the door at 1.07..2.05 with its window 1.28..1.70: 35-40 cm further forward and 23 cm wider; extrapolating the fit below 4 m is less sure (held-out window edge at 3.62: -9 cm). Window heights 1.72..3.05 from p004's column at u 2450 scaled by the short window's 1.081 m frame (the drawing: 1.84..2.92).
trace.cab.doors[1,2]: dia centres 586.5 and 1085.5 px -> 7.357 and 14.303 m (the 455's spacing, confirmed there on a photo). p004: door 1's near yellow edge at 6.253 m (centre about 7.30 if the surround is the 455's 2.10 m), door 2's at 13.112 (14.16): 6-14 cm ahead of the drawing, read through the door recess; the drawing kept. Leaves, windows and spans as the 455 (same body and doors; see classes/455 trace).
trace.cab.windows: Glass, dia row 140 less 58 px: 353..473, 700..820, 852..972, 1199..1319, 1351..1471 px -> 4.106..5.776, 8.936..10.606, 11.052..12.722, 15.882..17.552, 17.998..19.668 (p004 fit: frames within 2.3 cm). The short window behind the cab door from p004: frame 2.81..3.62 (u 2370..2307) -> glass about 2.85..3.58; the drawing has it 2.49..3.65 (0.45 m wider, its front edge 38 cm further forward on the fit).
trace.cab.bogies, under: dia: bogies 267, 1285 px -> 2.909, 17.079; underframe boxes 532..1130 px -> 6.60..14.92 (the motor car's).
trace.next: DTSO: the cab car reversed (dia 1581..3046 px: doors 6.10/13.05 m from the inner end, wheels at 1708..1930 and 2728..2948 px -> bogies 3.33/17.50); underframe 1975..2573 px -> 5.48..13.81. Its far end is a cab: the pipeline draws the second car's far end plain (needs an option).
trace.face.scale: p004 (Canon 100D, 38 mm, near head-on from the right): horizontal 296 px/m from the red skirt's silhouette (2598..3433 px = 2.82 m, so foreshortened by the yaw, applying equally to both sides), measured as half the distance between mirrored features; vertical 323 px/m from the skirt's foot (0.123 m, dia row 335, at v 2153) to the roof (3.78 at v 971): y = 0.123 + (2153 - v)/323.
trace.face.panel: Yellow: v 1461..1746 -> 2.265..1.383 m, edges at 2623/3405 px -> +-1.32; lower outer corners rounded. Its middle section (2841..3177 px, +-0.57) stands proud: not modelled.
trace.face.dark: One black windscreen surround 2623..3378 px, v 1147..1459 -> +-1.275, 2.272..3.237. Destination display in the left pane's top (as seen from the front): 2678..2962 px, v 1178..1241 -> -1.04..-0.08, 2.95..3.14, drawn dark across the pane's width from 2.95 up. Coupler recess: 2851..3197 px, v 1875..2124 -> +-0.585, 0.21..0.984, top corners about 0.15. The display is in the +z (train's right) pane, see face.screens.
trace.face.screens: Two panes either side of a thin centre pillar (2972..3000 px): glass 2650..2972 and 2999..3346 px, v 1154..1449 -> inner +-0.045, outer +-1.18 (mean of both sides), 2.303..3.216; the left pane ends at the display (2.93). Side: the display pane is the left one as seen from ahead, the train's right (+z, far): p004 and p006 both show it there. Mirrored 2026-10-06 (it had been placed on the near side).
trace.face.lampUnits: Head (clear reflector) outboard at 2751/3292 px -> 0.914; LED cluster (marker/tail) inboard at 2813/3229 -> 0.703; centres v 1683 -> 1.575; r 28 px -> 0.09 m each. Same order on p020c and p006 (head outboard). The LED cluster reads red unlit on p004 and lit red on p020c (second reader): tailLens red.
trace.face.shapes: Under the yellow: blue strip v 1746..1771 -> 1.383..1.306, orange line 1771..1795 -> 1.306..1.231, red below to the foot (redf-004). Orange line over the screens: v 1133..1146 -> 3.28..3.24, edge to edge, carrying on along the sides.
trace.face.number: '456004' in white on the red each side: centres 2754/3296 px -> 0.915 (mean), v 1893 -> 0.928 m, 31 px -> 0.10 m high.
trace.face.wipers: Parked flat along the bottom of each pane: pivots 2938/3083 px v 1482 -> 0.245, 2.20 (on the yellow's top edge); blade ends 2654/3346 px v 1416/1400 -> 1.17, 2.42.
trace.form: Width 2.82 published; corners rounder than the 455's in plan (p004, p006): setback 0.15, squareness 6; gasket glazing.
trace.liveries.SW.colours: Balanced against white-004 (wordmark stroke, overcast): red-004 #E55349, blue-004 #3356B8 (below the cab door's window, out of the reflections; the 455's sample was #325BC9), orange-004 #F19930, yellow-004 #E7C337, doorblue-004 #45558D. Front: redf-004 #D82018 against the white number (the front's lower red is deeper than the bodyside's in this photo); the front yellow saturates (raw #FFCC27), so the door-surround yellow is used for the panel. Surround: surround-004 raw #3C3E41 (glossy black). Roof: no clean sample in these photos; the 455's #6A6468 (same livery).
trace.liveries.SW.shapes: Cab-end sweep from dia (per-row extents of #000080/#FF8000 behind the nose, sweep.py), spline-smoothed (max residual 6.7 cm; the orange's rear edge is hidden by the windows between 2.1 and 3.1 m and interpolated) and sampled every 0.2 m. p004 row 1440 (y about 2.6): blue to 2.31, orange 2.39..2.76: the drawing has blue to 2.24 there. The blue's lower edge at the front, about 1.1 m on the drawing, is 1.31 m on the face (p004): left as drawn on the side.
trace.liveries.SW.rects: Orange cantrail line: dia rows 61..63 -> 3.455..3.48. Waist line behind door 2 on the cab car and on the DTSO's inner half: p004 (s-waistline crop) at about 1.46..1.50 m (the drawing has it at rows 234..237, 1.33..1.36, the 455's drawing at 1.52..1.55). Door surrounds as the 455's, with the yellow carried over the top of each door (p004, s-door1: a yellow arch 0.07 m deep above the leaves; the drawing omits it).
trace.liveries.SW.branding: SWR wordmark between doors 1 and 2: p004 fit 9.43..12.41 m (3.0 m, as on the 455), centre 10.9; y 1.48 from the window frame bottom (2.027) at u 1900 and 194 px/m; height 0.357 from the 3.0 m length and the artwork's aspect (8.4). The DTSO carries it between its doors too (p004 s-dtso), centred 9.58 from its inner end. Artwork: classes/455/logo/SW-wordmark.svg (to move to logos/SW-wordmark.svg).
